traefik.enable=true
traefik.docker.network=proxy
traefik.http.routers.${COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME}-shop.rule=(Host(`example.com`) || Host(`www.example.com`)) && PathPrefix(`/shop`)
traefik.http.routers.${COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME}-shop.entrypoints=websecure
traefik.http.routers.${COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME}-shop.tls.certresolver=letsencrypt
traefik.http.routers.${COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME}-shop.priority=105
traefik.http.routers.${COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME}-shop.service=${COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME}-shop
traefik.http.routers.${COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME}-shop.middlewares=${COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME}-hsts
traefik.http.services.${COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME}-shop.loadbalancer.server.port=5000
traefik.http.middlewares.${COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME}-hsts.headers.stsSeconds=31536000
